method: Same installed Chrome in normal and --js-flags=--jitless modes. No job CPU quota or page throttle. Actual dedicated Worker arithmetic verifies the slower runtime across five alternating pairs per viewport. This is not a constant CPU slowdown, frequency or phone equivalence. Jitless interprets user JS and disables WebAssembly; the four custom providers use JS only. Arithmetic factors must not be applied to chess timings. Original and current actual providers/Workers use identical eight positions, five seeds and burst request order. All completed rows including errors retained. Candidate moves, nodes and depth must match across modes/viewports. Startup and first replies separate. No production-runtime or physical-phone claim.

serverPreparation.method: Dev-server compilation only, before browser measurements. Client module parsing, Worker startup and first replies remain measured.
